def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- Orders known at seed_time: purchase happened before seed_time ---
    ord_cols = orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status",
                       "order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                       "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]
    items = order_items.merge(ord_cols, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items[items["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    items = items[items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    # --- Sales counts in windows ---
    ts_col = "order_purchase_timestamp"
    for w in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        sub = items[items[ts_col] >= cutoff]
        feats[f"sales_last_{w}d"] = sub.groupby("product_id").size().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats[f"revenue_last_{w}d"] = sub.groupby("product_id")["price"].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats[f"orders_last_{w}d"] = sub.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)

    # --- Lifetime aggregates ---
    if len(items) > 0:
        agg = items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            distinct_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            distinct_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            first_purchase=(ts_col, "min"),
            last_purchase=(ts_col, "max"),
        )
    else:
        agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=["total_sold", "total_revenue", "avg_price", "max_price",
                                    "total_freight", "avg_freight", "distinct_sellers",
                                    "distinct_orders", "first_purchase", "last_purchase"])
    for c in ["total_sold", "total_revenue", "avg_price", "max_price",
              "total_freight", "avg_freight", "distinct_sellers", "distinct_orders"]:
        feats[c] = agg[c].reindex(idx).fillna(0)

    feats["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - agg["first_purchase"].reindex(idx)).dt.days
    feats["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - agg["last_purchase"].reindex(idx)).dt.days
    # products never sold: large sentinel
    big = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-01-01")).days + 1
    feats["days_since_first_purchase"] = feats["days_since_first_purchase"].fillna(big)
    feats["days_since_last_purchase"] = feats["days_since_last_purchase"].fillna(big)

    # --- Reviews: only reviews already created before seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    prod_orders = items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    rev_m = prod_orders.merge(rev, on="order_id", how="inner")
    if len(rev_m) > 0:
        ragg = rev_m.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].agg(["mean", "count", "min", "max"])
    else:
        ragg = pd.DataFrame(columns=["mean", "count", "min", "max"])
    feats["avg_review_score"] = ragg["mean"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feats["review_count"] = ragg["count"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feats["min_review_score"] = ragg["min"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feats["max_review_score"] = ragg["max"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    # share of low reviews among reviewed orders
    if len(rev_m) > 0:
        low = rev_m[rev_m["review_score"] <= 2].groupby("product_id").size()
        tot = rev_m.groupby("product_id").size()
        share = (low / tot).reindex(idx)
    else:
        share = pd.Series(np.nan, index=idx)
    feats["low_review_share"] = share.fillna(0)

    # --- Payments: known at purchase time (order already before seed_time) ---
    pay = payments[["order_id", "payment_installments", "payment_value", "payment_type"]]
    pay_m = prod_orders.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="inner")
    if len(pay_m) > 0:
        pagg = pay_m.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
            avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
            total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        )
        ntypes = pay_m.groupby("product_id")["payment_type"].nunique()
        credit = pay_m[pay_m["payment_type"] == "credit_card"].groupby("product_id").size()
        norders = pay_m.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        feats["avg_installments"] = pagg["avg_installments"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["max_installments"] = pagg["max_installments"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["avg_payment_value"] = pagg["avg_payment_value"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["total_payment_value"] = pagg["total_payment_value"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["n_payment_types"] = ntypes.reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["credit_card_share"] = (credit / norders).reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    else:
        for c in ["avg_installments", "max_installments", "avg_payment_value",
                  "total_payment_value", "n_payment_types", "credit_card_share"]:
            feats[c] = 0.0

    # --- Delivery performance: only for orders delivered BEFORE seed_time ---
    deliv = items[items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() &
                  (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)].copy()
    if len(deliv) > 0:
        deliv["delay_days"] = (deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                               deliv["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        deliv["ship_days"] = (deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                              deliv["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        dagg = deliv.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_delivered=("order_id", "nunique"),
            avg_delay=("delay_days", "mean"),
            avg_ship_days=("ship_days", "mean"),
        )
        late = deliv[deliv["delay_days"] > 0].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        feats["n_delivered"] = dagg["n_delivered"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["avg_delay"] = dagg["avg_delay"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["avg_ship_days"] = dagg["avg_ship_days"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feats["late_share"] = (late / dagg["n_delivered"]).reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    else:
        for c in ["n_delivered", "avg_delay", "avg_ship_days", "late_share"]:
            feats[c] = 0.0

    # --- Trend: sales in last 90d vs previous 90d ---
    c90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    c180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    recent = items[items[ts_col] >= c90].groupby("product_id").size()
    prev = items[(items[ts_col] >= c180) & (items[ts_col] < c90)].groupby("product_id").size()
    recent = recent.reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    prev = prev.reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feats["sales_trend"] = (recent - prev) / (prev + 1.0)

    # --- Momentum: days since last sale relative to typical gap ---
    feats["sales_per_day_lifetime"] = feats["total_sold"] / feats["days_since_first_purchase"].clip(lower=1)

    feats = feats.fillna(0).astype(float)
    feats = feats.reindex(entity_ids)
    return feats
